SELECT FROM tasks t JOIN events e ON e.id = t.event_id AND e.space_id = t.space_id WHERE t.id = #{taskId} AND t.space_id = #{spaceId} AND t.event_id = #{eventId} FOR UPDATE OF t

SELECT t.id AS task_id, t.title, t.status, t.version, t.assignee_user_id, u.display_name AS assignee_display_name, (count(i.id) FILTER (WHERE i.checked))::int AS done, count(i.id)::int AS total FROM tasks t LEFT JOIN users u ON u.id = t.assignee_user_id LEFT JOIN task_checklist_items i ON i.space_id = t.space_id AND i.event_id = t.event_id AND i.task_id = t.id WHERE t.space_id = #{spaceId} AND t.event_id = #{eventId} GROUP BY t.id, u.display_name
